title: Portal access
subtitle: Grant customers and vendors scoped external access. External principals are not organization members.
externalNote: External principals are not organization members. Public portal login is not enabled yet — grants are admin-managed only and never mutate financial truth.
vendorSubtitle: Vendor grants require a vendor scope (portal_kind vendor + vendorId). External users cannot change bills, expenses, or payments.
vendorFoundationNote: Public vendor login is still foundation-only. Scopes enable RFQ visibility, quote candidates, approved PO views, bill candidates, and compliance upload candidates. Candidates never post AP bills or expenses.
recordQuoteHint: Stores a supplier quote as received for procurement review. Does not finalize financials. External principals cannot accept or shortlist quotes.

preview.title: Preview customer-safe summary
preview.subtitle: See exactly what a customer grant would expose for a project. Costs, profit, rates and overhead never appear.
preview.notAllowed: That grant does not cover this project, is inactive, or lacks summary scopes.
preview.grantHint: Without a grant, preview uses project summary only. With a grant, scopes and coverage from that grant apply — including outstanding balance when allowed.
preview.empty: Run a preview to inspect the customer-safe projection.
preview.foundationNote: Public customer login is foundation-only. This preview is admin-mediated via ExternalPrincipal grants — not OrganizationMembership.

denials.crossCustomer: Cross-customer denial: this grant does not cover the selected project.
denials.grantInactive: Portal grant is inactive, revoked, or expired.
denials.scopeDenied: Grant scopes do not allow a customer project summary.

preview.noDocuments: documents.read is granted, but no project documents are linked yet.

vendorPreview.title: Preview vendor-safe portal
vendorPreview.subtitle: Inspect RFQs, approved POs, and candidate queues for a vendor grant. Profit, employee cost, overhead, and org admin never appear.
vendorPreview.notAllowed: That grant is inactive or not a vendor grant.
vendorPreview.empty: Run a preview to inspect the vendor-safe projection.
vendorPreview.candidatesOnly: Candidates only — never mutates AP bills, expenses, or payments
vendorPreview.rfqVisibilityNote: RFQs appear only when this vendor already has a linked supplier quote. Org-wide RFQ browse is blocked (invite table deferred).

candidateQuote.title: Submit quote candidate (grant-scoped)
candidateQuote.hint: Requires quote.submit on the grant. Stores supplier quote as received for internal review — never accepted/finalized by the external principal.
candidateQuote.saved: Quote candidate stored as received (not finalized).

candidateAp.title: Submit AP bill candidate
candidateAp.hint: Queues invoice candidate data for internal review. Does not create an AP bill or expense.

candidateCompliance.title: Submit compliance candidate
candidateCompliance.hint: Queues insurance/cert metadata for internal review. Does not create a valid compliance artifact.
candidateCompliance.name: Document name

candidateReview.title: Internal candidate review
candidateReview.subtitle: Accept or reject vendor portal candidates. Accepting only queues internal follow-up — it never posts AP bills, expenses, or compliance artifacts.
candidateReview.neverPosts: Candidates ≠ ledger truth. Financial posting remains a separate internal action.
candidateReview.reviewedCount: {count} already reviewed in this session store
